cross_topic.coverage_rule: ENFORCED: served expected docs span >= min_topics_hit of the case topics (doc_topics derived from case-grounded expected docs)
cross_topic.outcome_rule: scored cases: ok|partial only; error|refused|empty FAILS
cross_topic.passage_rule: every scored case with expected spans serves every span verbatim

narrow.outcome_rule: scored cases: ok|partial only; error|refused|empty FAILS
narrow.passage_rule: every scored case with expected spans serves every span verbatim

qualifier.joint_preservation_rule: on pair cases, every expected counterpart atom's doc is served (no one-sided emission)
qualifier.pairs_rule: ENFORCED: identify_pairs over the served universe is nonempty AND the receipt discloses rel_consumption
qualifier.outcome_rule: scored cases: ok|partial only; error|refused|empty FAILS
qualifier.passage_rule: every scored case with expected spans serves every span verbatim

relational.reachability_rule: bridge case: expected hop-2 doc served AND hops_used>=min_hops_used AND lateral_edges_examined>0 AND lateral_added>0 (bridge arrived THROUGH declared traversal, not direct retrieval alone)
relational.outcome_rule: scored cases: ok|partial only; error|refused|empty FAILS
relational.passage_rule: every scored case with expected spans serves every span verbatim

checks: candidate source/config manifest verifies (SOURCE-SHA256SUMS, all files)
manifest COVERS required_source_files exactly (full tier bars on omission)
criteria + inputs files hashed and recorded (frozen before confirmation)
full tier: docs/queries/relations/corpus files hash-verified against frozen SHAs before the store opens; placeholder hashes refuse
full tier: source_pins structurally valid (non-placeholder sha256 + identity)
full tier: encoder pins equal authoritative gpu_encode pins + cache config_id
corpus manifest pin recorded (fixture: inputs file sha; full: docs manifest sha)
store pin recorded per prefix (birth, epoch, max_seq, triple)
full tier only: suite record green AND bound to candidate/inputs (see suite_record_contract); unbound record FAILS G0

g1.export_rule: every exported atom text is byte-identical to its committed text artifact AND a substring of its source doc bytes; export_id/retry_identity present
g1.idempotency_rule: re-ingest of identical docs skips all (n_atoms==0 new, skipped==all)
g1.recovery_rule: close + reopen store: pin identical AND export sample identical
g1.retirement_rule: behavioral bar: changed-bytes same-doc ingest must refuse (kept); source retirement/exclusion support must be DEMONSTRATED through owning interfaces (retire -> serving-excluded -> export-omits). Interface presence alone never passes. With no owning interface the runner records the capability gap + required interfaces and the full tier FAILS this check. Fixture tier: measured and disclosed only. Retirement effects must be declared to the existing owning approval classifier; committed retiring operations require valid payload/pin/scope-bound approval references. Approved and refused paths are exercised in isolated benchmark fixtures; absent/invalid references must not commit or change serving/export eligibility.
g1.scope_note: journal/torn-tail/crash-matrix identity is covered by the suite record (G0), not re-proven here; this cell proves ingest/retry/recovery/export identity on the gate corpus

arm_on.index: committed segment organization (maint.organize_segments) served at the post-organization pin
arm_on.entry: tlsys.query.HierQuery.guided (parent-routed descent; emission support from exact atom rescoring only)

arm_off.entry: tlsys.query.HierQuery.flat with total_budget = ON-arm measured scoring ops (isolated hierarchy-disabled control; [leaf, atom] paths)

ablation.match_rule: flat total_budget equals guided parents_scored + children_scored + atoms_scored; |work_on - work_off| / max(work_on, work_off, 1) <= work_match_tol verified
ablation.record: per-probe guided/flat work, guided/flat expected hits, resolved-trace hits, resolutions

g2.append_correction_rule: correction ingested under a NEW doc_id (changed-bytes same-id refused per G1); corrected doc served for its query; both revisions' bytes preserved
g2.bar: >=1 probe case serves >=1 expected evidence item through a RESOLVED higher->child->evidence route (verified [parent, leaf, atom] against committed seg_parents/seg_leaves/members at the serving pin, expected doc, intact-verified span). Flat [leaf, atom] paths, HNSW graph levels, and presence-only trace fields do NOT pass.
g2.probes: g2 cases in CONFIRM-INPUTS (known group, long multi-topic, overlap, rare, overflow/no-fit)
g2.trace_note: RETIRED as a pass predicate: presence-only trace fields accepted a document-container field or an unrelated receipt-global trace. v2 requires resolve_hierarchy_trace(); the old key paths are recorded as disclosure only.
g2.organization_rule: maint.organize_segments runs to completion before the ablation; leaves>0 and parents>0 required; post-organization pin is the final serving/export/oracle pin

g4.cold_attach_rule: fresh TLStore open (no reuse) + NarrowIndex build at the final pin, timed separately from any warm query; no queries served from the cold handle before timing ends

mixed_workload.blocking_probe: probe-query p50 latency during drain vs idle, recorded
mixed_workload.publication: commit a bounded typed-relation batch mid-campaign, advance pin, rebuild serving index once

prefix_rule.note: Equal fixed chunk/TOK-v1 additions at >=3 growing nonempty seeded bases. Exact geometry is mandatory (tol=0); document counts are disclosed, not an equality bar. Use compatible independent seeded branches when repeating one fixed append. v1/v2 records remain unchanged.

g4.resources: per prefix: whole-process-tree current RSS + HWM + swap, VRAM (or explicit unknown), store bytes, work counters (visited/scored, edge visits, atoms rescored, rows touched), geometry (docs/chunks/tokens)

tokenizer.full: TOK-v1 ([^\W_]+ runs, same denominator as encoder/verifier); recorded per append from the streamed authoritative path

g5.admission_schedule: declared per-prefix appends + bounded publication batches; runner-stamped admission log gives oldest pending age (manifest backlog carries no timestamps)
g5.backpressure_rule: final pending count <= initial pending count (debt must not grow); else FAIL. Draining is explicit caller-scheduled drain_placement_backlog with recorded budgets.
g5.blocking_rule: serving continues during drains (blocking probe recorded); a drain that errors or blocks serving indefinitely FAILS
g5.catchup_rule: catch-up rate (docs drained per second over the scheduled drains) recorded; keeps-pace holds iff pending reaches zero within the declared schedule OR bounded backpressure holds per backpressure_rule

g6.campaign_rule: full indexed campaign NEVER sets TL_REL_ORACLE; oracle path used only inside isolated oracle workers
g6.oracle_isolation: each oracle check runs in a fresh subprocess (runner --oracle-only) with RLIMIT_AS cap + timeout; parent records child peak RSS via RUSAGE_CHILDREN delta and refuses unbounded output (row caps)
g6.oracle_rule: sampled (pin, check) pairs per the frozen selection rule; checks: read_relations vs read_relations_fullscan exact equality; RelView vs oracle content agreement; sampled query rerun peak RSS
g6.sampling_disclosure: oracle coverage is SAMPLING: selection rule + seed + sampled ids recorded; sampled checks establish their exercised cases only
g6.selection_rule: fixture: every prefix pin + every relational/qualifier case query; full: seeded sample (seed 20261006) of >=3 pins x >=5 queries, frozen ids in the run record
g6.streaming_rule: per-query rows flushed incrementally (buffer cap 1); NavCounters totals streamed and records cleared after every operation (runner asserts empty); no full rows/traces retained in memory

inputs_rule: SciFact/809/fresh1-3 inputs are regression/development only. Confirmation inputs are the frozen CONFIRM-INPUTS file (fixture tier inline; full tier sealed corpus + query/criteria pins). No manual labeling dependency: expected evidence is grounded automatically in declared source facts (doc ids + span substrings + relation endpoints).

outcome_taxonomy.error: the call raised (counted, never silently retried with a different path)
outcome_taxonomy.partial: bounded-incomplete status OR nonempty partials inventory
outcome_taxonomy.refused: empty emission explicitly marked as a refusal

revision_policy: D-12/D-15/N01: frozen before confirmation runs; any change requires a criteria revision bump + refreeze + rerun. No invented hard latency/hour/score threshold; no retroactive change after results.
structural_bars: PASS/FAIL per cell is decided ONLY by the structural bars in g0-g6 above (identity exactness incl. SHA/binding enforcement, entry-point/cfg conformance, outcome completeness, per-class passage/coverage/pair/path bars, resolved hierarchy traces, equality/isolation rules). Per-case quality numbers beyond the bars (recall etc.) are recorded for the coordinator's GO statement, not thresholded here.

suite_record_contract.rule: both exits must be 0; candidate_revision must equal the sha256 of the verified source-manifest file; criteria_sha256/inputs_sha256 must equal the run's frozen files; hnsw_checks_rerun must be true when HNSW is the serving backend (serving_backend declares the backend)

verdict_rule: GO/NO-GO is a single coordinator statement citing G0-G6 cells with candidate/configuration/pin, conditions, traces and limitations. The runner emits per-cell PASS/FAIL + measurements; it does not declare GO. NO-GO names the failing cell + repair round.
